source_scope.description: An explicit Add AI action continues after state discovery, with cancellation and stale-read fencing. Other Android src/main production inputs match code44; this does not transfer code44 device observations to code45.

build_and_checks.core_scope: Local host fixtures and workerd checks. They are separate from device and personal-AI acceptance.

native_invitation_suite.method: Disposable emulator, synthetic identities and test CA; actual production Activity/dialog Button.performClick callbacks and HTTP/service/storage effects. Read-only test reflection checks Owner state. This is not physical touch or first-user setup.

checks.name: One Add callback from unknown state creates exactly one invitation after a real grants read
STOP while the Add read is held does not create a late invitation
Canceling the original unknown invitation while its read is held does not recreate it
HOME pause abandons the pending Add read; resume does not create an invitation
Retry after an invitation POST commits but loses its reply retains the original identity, sequence and ticket

limits: The three canceled connections were already closed at release; this proves real cancellation and no late creation, not that a stale success callback arrived. Focused host tests separately inject stale and duplicate callbacks.
The earlier gesture/file-IO suite and code44 migration suite were not rerun for this candidate.
No public service, physical phone, Muse or Instinct participated in this native suite.

preconditions_and_interventions: This is the already prepared device with retained accounts and authorization, existing Flyme background/startup settings and the earlier code42 manual accessibility rebind.
A maintainer issued adb install -r. No uninstall, clear-data, re-pairing, postinstall foreground launch, phone UI action or permission toggle was used for this upgrade.
The initial binding sampler was wrong and was corrected in the observation tool; this was a measurement correction, not a phone setting change.

binding_measurement_error.cause: The sampler searched for the package name in Bound services, where this Android build prints the service label.
binding_measurement_error.interpretation: The seven false binding values are retained as invalid measurements, not binding failures and not retroactively changed to true. The first foreground-service=false sample is an actual startup observation and is retained.

corrected_followup.method: Read-only accessibility metadata matched the Airtap service label, with separate enabled-service and foreground-service checks.

upgrade.scope: Local diagnostics and three later valid binding checks establish this limited automatic reconnect on one prepared phone, not a completed personal-AI task.

not_established: A full 60-minute code45 idle test. The separate completed hour belongs only to code44.
Muse or Instinct actual tasks, autonomous wake, SMS GUI reading, physical multi-AI handoff or subsequent-use verification on code45.
First installation, all OEMs, reboot/deep-Doze recovery or unplugged endurance.
Public APK39 replacement, independent new-user acceptance or production relay deployment. The relay deployment is outside this record.
privacy: Manually reduced to build identity, model, timings and diagnostic classifications. No serial, PID value, account, phone number, raw chat/screen, credential or private deployment path is included.
